title: Howling Blight
description: Howling Blight adds corrupted zombie wolves that spread a deadly blight and powerful illager Wargs that fight alongside raiding parties.
body:
# Howling Blight

Something is wrong with the wolves.

Stories from wandering traders speak of packs that no longer fear the sun, their fur matted and their jaws dripping with rot. Villagers whisper that the illagers have begun breeding darker beasts in the depths of woodland mansions — larger, crueler wolves that fight alongside them in raids. Hunters call them **Wargs**.

But the real danger isn’t the beasts themselves.

It’s the **blight**.

When wolves fight the undead, the corruption can spread. A bite from a zombie or one of the twisted zombie wolves may infect them. Even feeding your loyal companion rotten flesh could seal its fate. A once-loyal wolf might soon join the growing pack of undead prowling the forests at night.

Not every beast has fallen, though. Illager warbands now march with powerful Wargs — massive wolves bred for war. They are stronger, tougher, and far more dangerous than the wolves of the wild.

If you travel with wolves, be careful.

The pack may not stay loyal forever.

---

## Features

**Zombie Wolves**
  - Faster than normal wolves
  - Drop rotten flesh
  - Can spread the blight to wolves when they attack

**Wolf Infection Mechanic**
  - Wolves and tamed wolves can become **Zombie Wolves** after being attacked by zombies
  - Feeding wolves **rotten flesh** risks infecting them

**Wargs**
  - Powerful illager war beasts
  - Spawn during **raids** and in **woodland mansions**
  - More health and stronger attacks than normal wolves
  - Immune to turning into zombie wolves

**Compatibility**
Integrates with **Hostile Harmony** if installed so illagers won’t accidentally damage their own Wargs

---

# Advancements

### 🧟 The First Bite
Your wolf has been exposed to the blight.

### 🐺 Loyal No More
Watch a tamed wolf turn into a Zombie Wolf.

### 🦴 Questionable Diet
Feed a wolf rotten flesh.

### 🌑 Something in the Pack
Encounter your first Zombie Wolf.

### ⚔ War Beast
Defeat a Warg.

### 🏹 Break the Pack
Defeat a Warg during a raid.

### 🏰 Beasts of the Mansion
Find a Warg inside a Woodland Mansion.

### ☣ Blight Spreads
Witness a wolf become infected after fighting the undead.

### 🐾 Hunter of the Blight
Defeat multiple Zombie Wolves.

### 🔥 No Mercy
Defeat a Zombie Wolf that used to be yours.
